name: qualtrics
description: Connects Claude to Qualtrics. Ask in plain English to list your surveys, see how one is built, check quotas and distributions, or export responses.

api_token.title: Qualtrics API token
api_token.description: Your personal Qualtrics API token. Brianna will send you yours. Paste it here exactly, with no spaces.

data_center.title: Qualtrics datacenter
data_center.description: Leave this as yul1 unless you have been told otherwise.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Leave this as true. Claude can read and export your Qualtrics data but cannot create, change or delete anything. Only set this to false if Brianna has asked you to.
